scope: Ordinary non-bypass JOC wrapper, codec selector 10, single selected substream. Selected target rate code 5 maps to 1024 kbps. Other codes used only as controlled helper inputs; no complete alternate-rate encoding claim.
upstream_semantics: Configured JOC processing count: selected non-LFE synthesis count plus LFE-presence flag. It is not source ADM channel count and is not an ID14 parser projection.

source_recipe.lfe_presence: Any nonnegative I16 code with ((code>>8)&127)==4 produces 1; negative codes are counted as object codes, not LFE. Multiple LFE-coded items still produce Boolean 1.
source_recipe.arithmetic: Exact integer counts, no scaling or float rounding; this selected formula cannot overflow I32.

config_parameter.explicit_query: First matching parameter supplies its I32 unchanged; standalone query can bypass validation, so query success alone is not valid API acceptance.
config_parameter.validation_order: Configuration constructor writes header/selector before validating the parameter list; errors preserve the tested target slot but may mutate the prefix. No whole-object no-commit guarantee.

payload_rule.payload_after: Start with supplied previous U8[64]; write byte0=1 and byte1=count_i32&255; preserve bytes2..63.
payload_rule.legal_domain_note: Since validated count is1..16, low8 has no truncation in legal configurations. Probes272/-1 demonstrate underlying cast only, not supported inputs.
payload_rule.substream_rule: Native writes the last configured substream; with more than one substream it disables first stream enable. Only selected one-stream dynamic proof is supplied.
payload_rule.tail_initializer: Natural zero tail was observed, but its earliest initializer is not closed by this package. Model may represent two consumed bytes; do not invent a 64-byte all-zero producer.

failure.controlled_missing_parameter_context: Earlier controlled calls without the natural option context returned35 after writing additional-BSI bytes. Those are retained as partial-write evidence, not success vectors.
